title: Rationale
html:
Rationale

The Fed's rate is 4.75% or higher after its April 28, 2027 meeting

An AI bust is a growth and financial-conditions shock, and Fed staff called AI-related demand 'a material source of inflation risk'. If the build-out breaks, the Fed has less reason to keep raising, so three or more further rises by April become less likely than otherwise: 0.25 against 0.44 overall. The bust can arrive after rises already made, which is why it is not lower.
